digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center outbound comment send path
propositions: Jira Data Center outbound comments are never fitted to the deployment-resolved ceiling before sending to the Jira client, causing over-length comments to be rejected and re-emitted in every sync pass.
_DCSanitizer.sanitize_comment exists but has no production caller, leaving the send path unwired while fit_comment is live in the comparison half.
The RECONCILER_MARKER must be preserved during comment fitting on the send path, matching the marker-preserving fitter used in Cloud's send path.
The dedup key (fit_comment) must equal the marker-stripped body that actually lands on the wire to maintain consistency with the send-side composition.
Cloud's sanitize_comment is dead code with an unsafe 32,767-char cap that would truncate RECONCILER_MARKER if wired, and should be removed from the protocol and all callers.
